verdict.rationale: GitLab documents a broad REST API for automating workflows, multi-project CI/CD management and programmatic user-access control. Its OpenAPI 3.0 spec is autogenerated from the API code, every endpoint can be tried interactively, and v4 has a semver versioning and deprecation policy. That shows a mature first-party programmatic surface, but nothing in the evidence states or shows full UI-to-API parity, which is the heart of this story. missing for 10: an explicit documented UI/API parity commitment, evidence that UI-only features (e.g., admin and settings areas) are covered by the API, independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage breadth.
